shared_elements: figures arranged along a horizontal register
justification: Both surfaces include human figures and animals set out along a horizontal field, but that is as far as the correspondence goes: A shows a few faint, isolated schematic stick-like figures with radiating limbs on an open ground, while B depicts a densely detailed architectural scene with columns, terraced walls, stairways, processions of robed guards and a lion attacking a bull. The specific forms, groupings and level of naturalism are entirely unrelated, and B's defining motifs (columns, the lion-and-bull combat, ordered files of attendants) have no counterpart in A.
